response.rationale: The clinical picture of unilateral facial pain in V2/V3 with triggers and allodynia is most consistent with trigeminal neuralgia, though the allodynia and vaccine association raise the possibility of trigeminal neuropathy. Normal MRI excludes structural causes. Dental and TMJ disorders are less likely given the specific trigeminal distribution and lack of local findings.
